articles.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Pan American Silver Corp. (NYSE: PAAS) (TSX: PAAS) ("Pan American") will announce its unaudited financial results for the second quarter of 2026 after market close on Wednesday, August 12, 2026. A conference call and webcast are planned for 11:00 am ET (8:00 am PT) on Thursday, August 13, 2026. Second Quarter
articles.title: Pan American Silver to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
